title: Wickford Boat Rentals

services.name: Charter Vessels
services.desc: Wickford Boat Rentals now offers half day and full day charters with a licensed Captain on board who will take you on a carefree excursion around Rhode Island’s beautiful coastline. Take a trip to a favorite anchorage for a swim off the stern of our select charter vessels (Sea Fox Commander 266 and Catalina 30 MK III to name a few), have a box lunch from one of our friends in a quiet cove, go shopping over in Newport or just explore Narragansett Bay. You can even take a day trip over to Block Island and relax in one of the nicest harbors on the East Coast.
